dashboard.layout: Sidebar on left, main content area taking remaining width
dashboard.top_bar: Search input, Notifications bell, Profile avatar
dashboard.kpi_row: 4 metrics cards (Total Decisions, Active, Completed, Avg Confidence). Each with JetBrains Mono numbers, and trend indicators (green/red deltas).
dashboard.signature_row: Grid with 4 columns. Col-span-1: Decision Health Score (large glowing 87/100, circular progress, 4 factor checks with green/orange dots). Col-span-3: Decision Trends Multi-series Line Chart with toggle for Daily/Weekly/Monthly.
dashboard.analytics_row: Grid with 4 columns. Col-span-2: Decision Categories Bar Chart (Orange/Purple colors). Col-span-2: Risk Distribution Donut Chart (Glowing inner shadow).
dashboard.bottom_row: Grid with 4 columns. Col-span-3: Recent Decisions Table. Col-span-1: AI Recommendations List (3 stacked cards with light bulb icon and action button).

pages.decisions_list: Full page data table with advanced filters (Status, Risk, Category) and pagination.
pages.new_decision: Multi-step form wizard or grid layout form with inputs for Objective, Category, Stakeholders, Deadline, Context.
pages.ai_chat: Chat interface with message bubbles. AI messages in slate-800, user messages in violet-600. Input box at bottom.
pages.analytics: Deeper full-page charts grid. Recharts integration.
pages.sources: Grid of connected data sources cards (CRM, ERP, Web Analytics) with sync status indicators.
pages.settings: Vertical tabs layout (Profile, Notifications, Security, API Keys).
pages.about: Simple markdown-style content page with version info and team.
pages.auth: Login/Register split layout. Left side abstract data viz image, right side clean minimalist form.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure all interactive elements and key informational areas include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., `data-testid="login-submit-button"`).
Use Shadcn UI components heavily customized to match the provided CSS classes in this JSON.
Use Recharts for all charts. Style Recharts tooltips with glassmorphism to match cards.
Do not use generic Inter font. Apply Sora for headings, Manrope for body, JetBrains Mono for metrics.
Ensure the Sidebar navigation contains Dashboard, Decisions, New Decision, AI Chat, Analytics, Sources, Settings, About.
The Decision Health Score card must be the focal point of the dashboard. Use a heavier glow and border treatment as specified in signature_card.
Do not use placeholder image URLs like via.placeholder.com. Only use the ones provided in this document.
